name: ffwf-tau-code
description: Clients for the tau agent harness: a connection server, a web client, and a VS Code extension.
//internal-deps: The five @ffwf/tau-code-* packages depend on each other by `*`, not by version. None of them is published to npm and none is meant to be (ARCHITECTURE 9.1), so a range npm cannot resolve from the registry is the only kind that works: an exact pin links the workspace only while the two numbers happen to agree, and silently becomes an unresolvable registry fetch the moment a release bumps one of them. `*` always matches the sibling on disk. Do not 'correct' these to the current version.
//workspaces: Order matters: npm builds workspaces in this order, and packages/server's build copies packages/web/dist-web into itself, so web has to be built first.
